core.files.setting.max_bytes.title: Largest file that can be uploaded
core.files.setting.max_bytes.description: In bytes. A bigger upload is refused with a message that names this limit. Between 1 MiB (1048576) and 1 GiB (1073741824).
core.files.setting.quota_bytes.title: Total storage for uploaded files
core.files.setting.quota_bytes.descripti: In bytes, for all files together. 0 means no limit. Once the total is reached, new uploads are refused until files are removed.
core.files.setting.max_per_record.title: Files allowed on one record
core.files.setting.max_per_record.descri: How many files one record, such as a qualification or an incident, may hold. Between 1 and 200.
